title: Famous darts and snooker players and their country

source.name: Wikidata (CC0)
source.method: sparql:SELECT ?item ?itemLabel ?article ?sitelinks ?countryLabel WHERE { { SELECT ?item ?sitelinks (SAMPLE(?c) AS ?country) (COUNT(DISTINCT ?c) AS ?nCountry) WHERE { VALUES ?occ { wd:Q17165321 wd:Q18574233 } ?item wdt:P106 ?occ ; wikibase:sitelinks ?sitelinks . FILTER(?sitelinks > 3) ?item wdt:P27 ?c0 . OPTIONAL { ?item wdt:P19/wdt:P131* ?uk . ?uk wdt:P31 wd:Q3336843 . } BIND(IF(?c0 = wd:Q145 && BOUND(?uk), ?uk, ?c0) AS ?c) } GROUP BY ?item ?sitelinks ORDER BY DESC(?sitelinks) LIMIT 400 } hint:Prior hint:runFirst true . FILTER(?nCountry = 1) OPTIONAL { ?article schema:about ?item ; schema:isPartOf <https://en.wikipedia.org/> . } SERVICE wikibase:label { bd:serviceParam wikibase:language "en,mul". } } ORDER BY DESC(?sitelinks) LIMIT 160
